acceptance.criterion: The phrase `5.6 sol high fast` resolves to the live Codex Sol model, high reasoning, and the live Fast service tier as separate argv values.
Bare `Grok` routes to Cursor with a live Cursor Grok model, `Grok Build` routes to the Grok CLI, and plain `Cursor` keeps the live Sol default.
Named pull request review requests resolve the repository and pull request, then route to the requested real review surface without editing the product repository.
Every supported seat uses smart-auto permissions, and dangerous bypass flags stay forbidden unless the user explicitly requests yolo.
Model availability checks fail closed on catalog, command, timeout, or parse failure, and the exhausted Fable case reports its reset and proposes live Opus xhigh.
`sh tests/smoke.sh` passes, the pull request checks pass on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and `git diff --check` passes.
README, prompt appendix, changelog, and plugin version describe the released behavior and version.

continuation_guard.next_required_action: Run the Fugu review and the independent host review.

master_acceptance.criterion: Lantern gives a short, correct field report and can route every documented herd task without editing a product repository.
Fugu and host reviews have no unresolved blocking finding at the final product tip.
The release version and GitHub release describe the tested routing and availability behavior.
